rows.backtranslation: The copy of the image automatically stored from an earlier time is put away separately in order for you to restore it.
rows.caller_contract: EditorDraftRecovery38–40 sets this only after preserveForRecovery(retainOriginal=true) returns. AutosaveStore105–111 copies the source to an atomic distinct ZIP; original is deliberately retained. Current predicate applies to this successful separate retention. Purpose describes potential future recovery of the earlier work, not successful restoration or repaired contents.

independent_review_findings.finding: Accept unchanged. The prior automatically stored image-copy is the nominal subject; the final separate-storage predicate describes the successful preservation that has just returned. Future-purpose recovery does not assert successful or guaranteed restoration. It can be replaced by a later legacy PNG restored status.

Applies to the resource at the missing-file precondition and the unused-by-current-production false-branch rename failure; do not claim a separately displayed current runtime route.

independent_review_findings.reason: Earlier automatically stored separate image-copy identifies the protected draft; Open action-topic plus exact RAM insufficiency identifies actual OOM. No policy-budget refusal, disk-space assertion, successful opening or repair guarantee.
